:::{#def-arccosine}
#### Arccosine

The **arccosine** $\arccos : [-1, 1] \to [0, \pi]$
is the [function](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/functions.html#def-function) that sends each [cosine](#def-cosine-sine), $c \in [-1, 1]$,
to the one [real number](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/number-systems.html#def-real-numbers) $\angpar \in [0, \pi]$ whose cosine is $c$.
By @thm-cosine-bijection, there is just one such $\angpar$.

:::
